title: Resurrection and Ascension

questions.question: On the first day of the week, at early dawn, the women went to the tomb carrying spices. What did they find regarding the stone?
options: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb
They found the stone sealed firmly shut entirely
They found Roman guards fast asleep leaning on the heavy stone
They saw angels pushing the stone securely off a cliff
questions.correctAnswer: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb
questions.explanation: Luke 24:2 (ESV): "And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb,"

questions.question: While they were perplexed about not finding the body of the Lord Jesus, two men stood by them in dazzling apparel. What did the men ask the frightened women?
options: "Why do you seek the living among the dead? He is not here, but has risen."
"Who rolled the stone away from the door completely?"
"Do you bring spices for a ghost?"
"Where did you see him last entirely?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Why do you seek the living among the dead? He is not here, but has risen."
questions.explanation: Luke 24:5-6 (ESV): "the men said to them, 'Why do you seek the living among the dead? He is not here, but has risen.'"

questions.question: The men reminded the women of what Jesus said while He was still in Galilee: "that the Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men..." and what else?
options: "...and be crucified and on the third day rise."
"...and be buried safely guarded by angels entirely."
"...and be thrown into prison for forty days."
"...and die swiftly beneath the sword completely."
questions.correctAnswer: "...and be crucified and on the third day rise."
questions.explanation: Luke 24:7 (ESV): "that the Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men and be crucified and on the third day rise."

questions.question: When the women (Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and others) returned from the tomb and told these things to the eleven, how did their words seem to the apostles?
options: These words seemed to them an idle tale, and they did not believe them
They seemed divine entirely, and the apostles immediately worshipped
They believed her immediately and ran shouting joyfully
They viewed them as a trick by the Romans thoroughly
questions.correctAnswer: These words seemed to them an idle tale, and they did not believe them
questions.explanation: Luke 24:11 (ESV): "but these words seemed to them an idle tale, and they did not believe them."

questions.question: Peter rose and ran to the tomb. Stooping, he saw only the linen cloths lying by themselves, and went home marveling. That very day, two of them were going to a village named what?
options: Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem
Bethany, on the slopes completely
Nazareth, in the region of Galilee safely
Jericho, down the dangerously winding road
questions.correctAnswer: Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Luke 24:13 (ESV): "That very day two of them were going to a village named Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem,"

questions.question: As the two men walked and discussed things, Jesus Himself drew near and went with them. Why did they not recognize Him initially?
options: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him
Because he wore a large hood entirely
Because the setting sun was glaring in their faces
Because he had radically changed his physical height
questions.correctAnswer: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him
questions.explanation: Luke 24:16 (ESV): "But their eyes were kept from recognizing him."

questions.question: One of them, named Cleopas, summarized what happened to Jesus, calling Him a prophet mighty in deed and word. They were disappointed because they had hoped what?
options: "...that he was the one to redeem Israel."
"...that he would overthrow Pilate instantly on Friday."
"...that he would become the high priest ultimately."
"...that he would call fire down upon the Romans."
questions.correctAnswer: "...that he was the one to redeem Israel."
questions.explanation: Luke 24:21 (ESV): "But we had hoped that he was the one to redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened."

questions.question: How did Jesus respond to their lack of understanding about why the Christ had to suffer?
options: "O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken! Was it not necessary that the Christ should suffer these things and enter into his glory?"
"Why are you so blind to the obvious miracle?"
"Did you sleep entirely while I taught clearly in the temple?"
"Repent deeply, for you doubt the angels themselves!"
questions.correctAnswer: "O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken! Was it not necessary that the Christ should suffer these things and enter into his glory?"
questions.explanation: Luke 24:25-26 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken! Was it not necessary that the Christ should suffer these things and enter into his glory?'"

questions.question: What did Jesus do as they continued walking towards Emmaus?
options: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself
He remained silent completely until they reached the village
He threw stones forcefully at passing birds rapidly
He commanded angels to appear securely above them
questions.correctAnswer: And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself
questions.explanation: Luke 24:27 (ESV): "And beginning with Moses and all the Prophets, he interpreted to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself."

questions.question: When they reached the table in Emmaus, what action finally opened their eyes so they recognized Jesus before He immediately vanished?
options: He took the bread and blessed and broke it and gave it to them
He lifted his hands and showed the scars from the nails
He shouted his name loudly over the thunder
He removed his thick cloak violently revealing a white robe
questions.correctAnswer: He took the bread and blessed and broke it and gave it to them
questions.explanation: Luke 24:30-31 (ESV): "When he was at table with them, he took the bread and blessed and broke it and gave it to them. And their eyes were opened, and they recognized him. And he vanished from their sight."

questions.question: Returning to Jerusalem that very hour, they found the eleven. What did the disciples initially think when Jesus Himself then stood among them and said, "Peace to you!"?
options: They were startled and frightened and thought they saw a spirit
They immediately rejoiced entirely without any fear at all
They attacked him thinking he was a Roman guard wildly
They believed it was merely John attempting a joke entirely
questions.correctAnswer: They were startled and frightened and thought they saw a spirit
questions.explanation: Luke 24:37 (ESV): "But they were startled and frightened and thought they saw a spirit."

questions.question: To prove He was not a spirit, Jesus said: "See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself. Touch me, and see. For a spirit does not have..."?
options: "...flesh and bones as you see that I have."
"...blood and water freely flowing entirely."
"...sweat upon its brow surely."
"...the voice of a living man obviously."
questions.correctAnswer: "...flesh and bones as you see that I have."
questions.explanation: Luke 24:39 (ESV): "See my hands and my feet, that it is I myself. Touch me, and see. For a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see that I have."

questions.question: While they still disbelieved for joy and were marveling, Jesus completely proved He had a physical body by doing what?
options: He asked for something to eat, and they gave Him a piece of broiled fish, and He took it and ate before them
He drank an entire goblet of thick wine completely
He lifted Peter entirely off the floor showing his strength
He chopped wood for the fire flawlessly
questions.correctAnswer: He asked for something to eat, and they gave Him a piece of broiled fish, and He took it and ate before them
questions.explanation: Luke 24:41-43 (ESV): "he said to them, 'Have you anything here to eat?' They gave him a piece of broiled fish, and he took it and ate before them."

questions.question: Jesus declared that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in His name to all nations, beginning where?
options: From Jerusalem
From Rome entirely
From Samaria safely
From the ends of the earth entirely
questions.explanation: Luke 24:47 (ESV): "and that repentance for the forgiveness of sins should be proclaimed in his name to all nations, beginning from Jerusalem."

questions.question: He led them out as far as Bethany, lifted His hands, and blessed them. While He blessed them, what happened to Jesus?
options: He parted from them and was carried up into heaven
He transformed into a pillar of bright fire instantly
He walked completely across the sea to distant shores
He faded into the swirling mist rapidly
questions.correctAnswer: He parted from them and was carried up into heaven
questions.explanation: Luke 24:51 (ESV): "While he blessed them, he parted from them and was carried up into heaven."

key_verse_text: "He is not here, but has risen. Remember how he told you, while he was still in Galilee,"
